1.label: very_easy
1.summary: Find the explicitly marked parasite among three separated windows. Provoking it leaves the parent infected and spawns three echoes; move any of those four carriers into a large well with five recoverable resistance attempts.
1.natural_language: End the infestation. The unstable process is visibly marked.

2.label: easy
2.summary: Search the original seven overlapping anonymous windows and discover the unmarked replicating process through causal probing. The infected parent spawns two infected echoes; drag any of the three carriers into the original containment well.

3.label: medium
3.summary: Causally search nine densely overlapping unmarked windows. The infected parent produces one echo, leaving two possible carriers, and containment requires a smaller placement target.

4.label: hard
4.summary: Clear two causally gated waves totaling ten windows. Each active parasite leaves its parent infected and spawns one echo. Containing that strain removes its wave, relocates the well, and only then reveals the next search.
4.natural_language: Contain the active strain. Its removal opens the next wave at a relocated containment field.

5.label: very_hard
5.summary: Clear three causally gated waves totaling eleven windows. Each active parasite leaves its parent infected and spawns one echo. Every containment removes the current wave, reveals the next search, and moves to a smaller well; two resisted closes terminate the attempt.
5.natural_language: Contain the active strain. Each removal opens the next wave at a new, smaller containment field.

simplified.summary: Select a visible window, then use large Close selected and Move selected to containment proxy buttons.

full.summary: Close windows through their title-bar controls and directly drag an infected window into the containment well.
